main_text.l: fecundi modi est, cuius subiectum est de essentiâ prædi-

essentialis, seu essentiale à priori: in secundo proprium,
seu essentiale à posteriori. Necessarium καθ' ὅλου πρῶτον[?]
est, cuius prædicatum cum subiecto disponitur reciprocè. Hic
τὸ καθ' ὅλου respicit prædicatum, significans illud cum sub-
iecto sic cohærere, vt eo nec sit γενικώτερον, nec εἰδικώτερον:
πρῶτον autem conuenit subiecto, indicans illud esse
οἰκεῖον & germanum, ratione prædicati, quod illi non
ἄλλο, sed immediatè conueniat: vt, Deus est omnipotens.

page.notes: Line numbers in the left margin (5, 10, 15, 20 ...) are printed line counts, kept as notes at their lines. The margin number at the "meus cœlestis" line is hard to read and is copied as 15. The Greek words "πρῶτον" after "καθ' ὅλου" and the word after "sua" (read as sua[?]) are doubtful. The Greek in the second paragraph is read from a small scan. The signature "Q 2" is also doubtful. The catchword "co-" is the start of the next page's first word and is not repeated in the text.
